summary: Big Hill Lookout Tower near Robeline, torn down per the Wikipedia list; two sources put it in Natchitoches Parish, not Sabine. No build or staffing record found.

facts.status_note: Torn down, according to the Wikipedia list; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Wikipedia list marks the tower torn down; the list gives no date

evidence.supports: tower named Big Hill Lookout Tower
parish given as Sabine in the Wikipedia list
Central US Lookouts index lists BIG HILL
Natchitoches Parish is the parish given with the Big Hill entry
TopoZone lists Big Hill Lookout Tower in its Natchitoches County tower list
TopoZone gives the USGS map name Robeline for Big Hill
the list is for Natchitoches County
1915 funds for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen
evidence.quote: In 1915 funds were directed for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen.

evidence.supports: first steel fire tower built near Bogalusa in 1922
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

evidence.supports: site cannot be viewed on street view or older aerial imagery
evidence.quote: Unable to view on street view or older aerial imagery.

corrections.why: Central US Lookouts and TopoZone both place Big Hill in Natchitoches Parish; the Wikipedia list says Sabine, so the sources disagree and the editor should decide.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia lists Sabine Parish; Central US Lookouts and TopoZone list Natchitoches Parish. The story follows the two index sources.

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana
Map of Towers in Natchitoches County, Louisiana

notes_for_editor: Record says Sabine Parish; the Wikipedia list agrees, but Central US Lookouts and TopoZone both put Big Hill in Natchitoches Parish, so the county correction is proposed for you to accept or reject. Build, design, height, staffing, fires and access are not in any source read: the list and the two index pages carry only parish, nearest town, status and one note. Coordinates in the record match the list. anyplaceamerica and getamap returned 403 and were not used. No photos found.
